items.meaning: 该文档描述对 SMTP 服务的扩展，使 SMTP 服务器与客户端可使用 TLS 提供私密、经认证的通信。
TLS 使 SMTP 代理能够保护其部分或全部通信免受窃听者和攻击者侵害。
STARTTLS 是此处定义的 SMTP 服务名称。
STARTTLS 关键字用于告知 SMTP 客户端该 SMTP 服务器当前能够协商使用 TLS。
STARTTLS 命令不带参数。
公开引用的 SMTP 服务器不得要求使用 STARTTLS 扩展才能本地投递邮件。
items.constraint: A publicly-referenced SMTP server MUST NOT require use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally.
items.action: require use of the STARTTLS extension
items.object: STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in order to deliver mail locally

items.meaning: 非公开引用的 SMTP 服务器可以选择要求客户端在接受任何命令前先执行 TLS 协商。
当服务器要求先执行 TLS 协商时，对除 NOOP、EHLO、STARTTLS、QUIT 之外的每条命令应返回 530 回复码。
items.constraint: the server SHOULD return the reply code: 530 Must issue a STARTTLS command first to every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT.
items.action: return the reply code 530
items.object: every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT
items.condition: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may choose to require that the client perform a TLS negotiation before accepting any commands. In this case
items.exception: other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT

items.meaning: 收到 STARTTLS 命令的 220 响应后，客户端必须在发出任何其他 SMTP 命令前开始 TLS 协商。
items.constraint: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command, the client MUST start the TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands.
items.action: start the TLS negotiation
items.object: TLS negotiation
items.condition: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command

items.meaning: 若客户端在发出 STARTTLS 命令后发现某故障使其无法真正开始 TLS 握手，则应中止连接。
items.constraint: If, after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake, then it SHOULD abort the connection.
items.action: abort the connection
items.object: connection
items.condition: If, after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake

items.meaning: 若 SMTP 客户端使用 RFC 2920 定义的流水线，STARTTLS 命令必须是命令组中的最后一条命令。
items.constraint: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920, the STARTTLS command must be the last command in a group.
items.action: be the last command in a group
items.object: STARTTLS command
items.condition: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，双方必须立即根据所获得认证与隐私决定是否继续。
items.constraint: After the TLS handshake has been completed, both parties MUST immediately decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved.
items.action: decide whether or not to continue
items.object: whether or not to continue
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: 若 SMTP 客户端认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，则应在 TLS 协商完成后立即发出 SMTP QUIT 命令。
items.constraint: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete.
items.action: issue an SMTP QUIT command
items.object: SMTP QUIT command
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: 若 SMTP 服务器认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，则应对客户端的每条 SMTP 命令（QUIT 除外）以 554 回复码应答。
items.constraint: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD reply to every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.action: reply with the 554 reply code
items.object: every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command)
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后 SMTP 协议重置为初始状态，服务器必须丢弃从客户端获得的、并非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识（如 EHLO 命令参数）。
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the client
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.exception: which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself

items.meaning: 客户端必须丢弃从服务器获得的、并非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识（如 SMTP 服务扩展列表）。
items.constraint: The client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the server
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.exception: which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself

items.meaning: 客户端应在成功 TLS 协商后把 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送。
items.constraint: The client SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation.
items.action: send an EHLO command
items.object: EHLO command

items.meaning: TLS 握手后收到的 EHLO 响应中返回的 SMTP 服务扩展列表可能与握手前返回的列表不同。
客户端与服务器都必须知道是否存在活动的 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: Both the client and the server MUST know if there is a TLS session active.
items.action: know if there is a TLS session active
items.object: whether a TLS session is active

items.meaning: 若 TLS 会话已处于活动状态，客户端不得尝试启动 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: A client MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active.
items.action: attempt to start a TLS session
items.object: TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，服务器不得在响应 EHLO 命令时返回 STARTTLS 扩展。
items.constraint: A server MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed.
items.action: return the STARTTLS extension
items.object: STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: STARTTLS 在 Submission 端口上使用时是有效的 ESMTP 扩展。
SMTP 客户端与服务器都必须检查 TLS 协商结果，以确认是否达到可接受的认证与隐私程度。
items.constraint: Both the SMTP client and server must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved.
items.action: check the result of the TLS negotiation
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 为防御中间人攻击，客户端与服务器必须能够被配置为在成功传输邮件前要求对选定主机完成适当密码套件的成功 TLS 协商。
items.constraint: In order to defend against such attacks both clients and servers MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred.
items.action: be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.condition: In order to defend against such attacks

items.meaning: 还应提供在可能时使用 TLS 的附加选项。
items.constraint: The additional option of using TLS when possible SHOULD also be provided.
items.action: provide the additional option of using TLS when possible
items.object: the additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现可以提供记录与某对端通信时使用了 TLS、并在后续会话未使用时产生警告的能力。
items.constraint: An implementation MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session.
items.action: provide the ability to record that TLS was used and generate a warning
items.object: the ability to record TLS usage and warn

items.meaning: 由于 TLS 握手开始前的协议交互以明文进行且可能被主动攻击者修改，客户端与服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃握手开始前获得的所有知识。
items.constraint: For this reason, clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake.
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.object: any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: SASL EXTERNAL 机制可与 STARTTLS 命令结合使用以提供授权身份。
items.constraint: the SASL EXTERNAL mechanism [SASL] MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity.
items.action: be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command
items.object: the STARTTLS command
